notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: "dada is dead"
notes.notes:
Crate Punks has long been due for a big update! The old codebase was wrangled from the skeleton of an incomplete MMORPG engine... We've spent the last months rebuilding the entire game from scratch using the Godot engine.

What this means for you is superb controller support, bug resistance, and now that the code is much easier to work with, more frequent updates!

Also, the crate simulation is now even more detailed!
( If you still prefer the old style of crate physics, there's an option for that in the menu )

Crate to it!
-Rex & the team 🦖🦖🦖

notes.title: Crate Punks release date moved to December 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Crate Punks as a game is 100% ready to be played.

However, it is taking a bit of time to get through the approval process. There are some specific requirements unique to Steam that I wasn't aware I had to meet, so I had to add some things and submit the game for approval again.

Hopefully Crate Punks will be ready to release December 2nd.

I'll keep you posted!
